tabs.label: In der Mensa
tabs.instructions: Two students compare what they prefer. They use "du". Where does Elif like to read most?

audio.label: Listen to the dialogue: In der Mensa

transcript: Elif: Was machst du lieber, Daniel: lesen oder Filme sehen? What do you prefer doing, Daniel: reading or watching films?
Daniel: Ich sehe lieber Filme. Und du? I prefer watching films. And you?
Elif: Ich lese lieber. Am liebsten lese ich im Park. I prefer reading. Most of all I like reading in the park.
Elif: Nein, im Winter lese ich am liebsten im Café. No, in winter I like reading best in a café.

text:
• gern → lieber → am liebsten – like → prefer → like best
  • Filme sehen – to watch films
  • im Winter – in winter

tabs.label: Beim Sport
tabs.instructions: Two friends talk about sport. They use "du". Which sport does Lukas like best?

audio.label: Listen to the dialogue: Beim Sport

transcript: Anna Becker: Spielst du Tennis, Lukas? Do you play tennis, Lukas?
Lukas: Ich spiele nicht nur Tennis, sondern auch Badminton. I do not only play tennis, I play badminton too.
Anna Becker: Und welchen Sport machst du am liebsten? And which sport do you like doing best?
Lukas: Am liebsten schwimme ich. Und du? Swimming is my favourite. And you?
Anna Becker: Ich gehe lieber klettern. I prefer going climbing.

text:
• am liebsten – best of all
  • Welchen Sport machst du? – Which sport do you do? (welchen = masculine accusative)
  • klettern gehen – to go climbing
